lat: lqit s-sarut dyali f d-dar
en: I found my key at home.

lat: ma lqitsh l-ktab dyali l-bare7
en: I did not find my book yesterday.

lat: wash lqiti khedma jdida f r-rbat
en: Did you find a new job in Rabat?

lat: nta ma lqitish l-wlad f l-madrassa
en: You didn't find the kids at school.

lat: wash lqiti s-sak dyalek f t-tumubil
en: Did you (f.) find your bag in the car?

lat: nti ma lqitish n-nwader dyalek
en: You (f.) didn't find your glasses.

lat: huwa lqa l-flus f sh-shari3
en: He found money in the street.

lat: huwa ma lqash l-waqt l-bare7
en: He didn't find time yesterday.

lat: lqat khedma mezyana f l-banka
en: She found a good job at the bank.

lat: hiya ma lqatsh t-tobis f l-weqt
en: She didn't find the bus on time.

lat: 7na lqina me7ell mezyan f s-suq
en: We found a good shop in the market.

lat: ma lqinash l-7al l had l-mushkil
en: We didn't find the solution to this problem.

lat: wash ntuma lqitu d-dar sh-shahr l-fayt
ar: واش نتوما لقيتو الدار الشهر الفايت
en: Did you (pl.) find the house last month?

lat: ntuma ma lqitush blasa f l-otil
en: You (pl.) didn't find a place at the hotel.

lat: huma lqaw khedma mezyana f fass
en: They found a good job in Fez.

lat: huma ma lqawsh t-triq l l-m7etta
en: They didn't find the way to the station.

lat: dima kanlqa khuya f l-qehwa
en: I always find my brother at the café.

lat: ana ma kanlqash l-waqt bash nqra
ar: أنا ما كنلقاش الوقت باش نقرا
en: I don't find time to read.

lat: nta katlqa l-7all b s-sohola
en: You (m.) find the solution easily.

lat: nta ma katlqash s-sarut dyalek dima
ar: نتا ما كتلقاش الساروت ديالك ديما
en: You (m.) don't always find your key.

lat: nti katlqay l-khodra rkhisa hna
en: You (f.) find cheap vegetables here.

lat: nti ma katlqaysh r-ra7a f l-khedma
en: You (f.) don't find rest at work.

lat: huwa kaylqa kulshi f had l-7anut
en: He finds everything in this grocery store.

lat: huwa ma kaylqash s-s7ab f l-mdina
en: He doesn't find friends in the city.

lat: hiya katlqa l-fer7a m3a l-3ayla
en: She finds joy with the family.

lat: hiya ma katlqash l-flus l l-kra
en: She doesn't find the money for rent.

lat: 7na kanlqaw l-7ut tri f s-suq
en: We find fresh fish at the market.

lat: 7na ma kanlqawsh blasa f t-tobis
en: We don't find a place on the bus.

lat: ntuma katlqaw r-ra7a f l-ferma
en: You (pl.) find rest on the farm.

lat: ntuma ma katlqawsh l-makla zwina hna
ar: نتوما ما كتلقاوش الماكلة زوينة هنا
en: You (pl.) don't find good food here.

lat: huma kaylqaw l-khedma b z-zerba
en: They find work quickly.

lat: huma ma kaylqawsh t-teksi f l-lil
en: They don't find a taxi at night.

lat: ana ghadi nlqa l-kora f j-jnan
en: I will find the ball in the garden.

lat: ana ma ghadish nlqa l-khedma f l-3otla
ar: أنا ما غاديش نلقا الخدمة فالعطلة
en: I will not find work during the holiday.

lat: nta ghadi tlqa l-ktab f l-khzana
en: You (m.) will find the book in the cupboard.

lat: nta ma ghadish tlqa mushkil ghedda
ar: نتا ما غاديش تلقا مشكل غدا
en: You (m.) will not find any problem tomorrow.

lat: nti ghadi tlqay dar zwina f kaza
ar: نتي غادي تلقاي دار زوينة فكازا
en: You (f.) will find a nice house in Casablanca.

lat: nti ma ghadish tlqay l-7lib f l-7anut
ar: نتي ما غاديش تلقاي الحليب فالحانوت
en: You (f.) will not find milk at the shop.

lat: huwa ghadi ylqa s-sarut dyalu ghedda
ar: هو غادي يلقا الساروت ديالو غدا
en: He will find his key tomorrow.

lat: huwa ma ghadish ylqa l-waqt bash ysafer
ar: هو ما غاديش يلقا الوقت باش يسافر
en: He will not find time to travel.

lat: hiya ghadi tlqa khtha f r-rbat
en: She will find her sister in Rabat.

lat: hiya ma ghadish tlqa l-flus daba
ar: هي ما غاديش تلقا الفلوس دابا
en: She will not find the money now.

lat: 7na ghadi nlqaw l-7el l had sh-shghol
ar: حنا غادي نلقاو الحل لهاد الشغل
en: We will find the solution for this job.

lat: 7na ma ghadish nlqaw t-tabla f l-qehwa
ar: حنا ما غاديش نلقاو الطبلة فالقهوة
en: We will not find a table at the café.

lat: ntuma ghadi tlqaw khuya f l-biru
en: You (pl.) will find my brother in the office.

lat: ntuma ma ghadish tlqaw t-tobis daba
ar: نتوما ما غاديش تلقاو الطوبيس دابا
en: You (pl.) will not find the bus now.

lat: huma ghadi ylqaw dar jdida ghedda
ar: هما غادي يلقاو دار جديدة غدا
en: They will find a new house tomorrow.

lat: huma ma ghadish ylqaw l-khobz f l-lil
ar: هما ما غاديش يلقاو الخبز فالليل
en: They will not find bread at night.
